points.quote: A feature that only works on desktop, such as the terminal's pty host or native menus, is imported from `workbench.desktop.main.ts` only.
Each platform adds its own entry file on top: `workbench.desktop.main.ts` or `workbench.web.main.ts`.
Both builds share `workbench.common.main.ts`, which pulls in the workbench core and the contributions that work everywhere.
A contribution that needs a service with no web implementation either gets a web stub or stays out of the web entry.
The bundler follows imports, so a module nobody imports isn't in the bundle.
